svg.text: Rows go top to bottom, in your order.
THREE ROWS: THE START OF A PAGE

text.font-family: 'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', Palatino, Georgia, serif

svg.text: You never place anything by hand. You only say “next to” or “underneath”.
Wrong order? Swap two names and run it again. Nothing breaks, and nothing is lost.
